ANALYSIS
domain: SaaS product / workforce scheduling
tone: conversational friendly, practical expert
visual_density: balanced

COMPOSITION
The page has 10 markdown sections (with one dense section) against a 7-slot template (hero, stats, features, content-image, banner, testimonial, cta). Since there is no explicit stats/specs data or named testimonial quote in the markdown, we repurpose the slots and reuse `content-image` with mirroring to comfortably accommodate all 10 sections while keeping a balanced dark-to-light visual rhythm. "How a schedule gets built" is dense (~687 words, 8 logical steps) and will be split across two sections for readability.

NOTES
- "How a schedule gets built" is split across banner ([4]) and content-image ([3] mirror) to give proper pacing to the workflow steps.
- "About Shiftloom" adapts cleanly into slot [5] (testimonial/founder statement layout).
- "For the people on the rota" uses slot [1] (stats/grid layout) with overflow handling for clean structured presentation.
